title: Yankee Doodle Doctor
description: What started as a serious documentary about surgeons in uniform, evolved into a slapstick comedy satire by the doctors themselves, commenting on the horror of trying to preserve what war destroys.
quote: I think I just found my wristwatch. Or he’s giving birth to an alarm clock.
